How the wall works
Music

Click a cover to play it. + on a cover adds it to the queue. The buttons in the bar pick a list, a country, a genre or a mood.

Touch

Tap a cover to play it. The filters are under ⋯ in the top bar; Pause in the dock stops the wall.

P Space
Pause or resume the wall
M
Sound on or off
L
Song list and search
F
Fullscreen
? H
Help
Esc
Close

Nothing loads from outside until you play a song. Then the video comes from YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com) and the lyrics from LRCLIB (lrclib.net).
